summary: ACPICA in the kernel on QEMU's pc and q35 machines: the namespace loaded with no error counted, the SCI taken and the power button's event as KEY_POWER on its event device; a video bus of the suite's SSDT whose methods /proc/acpi/call fires, giving the brightness keys; and the kernel without ACPICA under rach2.noacpica; the scenario is machine/acpi_scenario.c

cases.behavior: on the pc machine ACPICA loads the firmware's namespace with no error counted, takes the SCI, and the power button's press reaches it and comes out as KEY_POWER on the event device Power Button

execution.cleanup: libetude-case ends the machine and removes its evidence, which it keeps after a failure

steps.does: boot the test image to the debug shell and read the boot's records
run evprobe on the power button's event device, press the button with QMP's system_powerdown once it asks, wait for the event's record and for evprobe's end, and end the machine with QMP's quit

assertions.checks: a whole record says acpi: acpica: N objects, 0 errors: ACPICA loaded the namespace and counted no error
a whole record says acpi: sci: line N: ACPICA's handler took the SCI's line
after QMP's system_powerdown the kernel records acpi: event: power button, the fixed event ACPICA took from the SCI
evprobe finds the event device Power Button, of the host's bus with phys LNXPWRBN/button/input0, reads KEY_POWER pressed and released after the press, prints EVPROBE OK and exits 0

progress.means: a step of the manifest has ended

native.reason: the case reads what ACPICA makes of QEMU's own tables and presses the power button through QMP; the Lenovo's acceptance checks ACPICA on its firmware

cases.behavior: on the pc machine with the suite's SSDT, a video bus of one output, the kernel finds the bus, /proc/acpi/call evaluates the SSDT's methods with their arguments and results, and the Notify of \RTST on the output comes out as KEY_BRIGHTNESSDOWN and KEY_BRIGHTNESSUP on the event device Video Bus

execution.cleanup: libetude-case ends the machine and removes its evidence, which it keeps after a failure

steps.does: boot the test image with the SSDT acpi_video.aml to the debug shell and read the boot's records
run evprobe on the video bus's event device, which calls the SSDT's methods through /proc/acpi/call and reads the keys of \RTST, and end the machine with QMP's quit

assertions.checks: a whole record says acpi: acpica: N objects, 0 errors: ACPICA loaded the namespace with the SSDT and counted no error
a whole record says acpi: video: bus \_SB.RVID, outputs 1: the SSDT's device with _DOS and _DOD was taken as a video bus with its output

evprobe finds the event device Video Bus, of the host's bus with phys LNXVIDEO/video/input0; /proc/acpi/call gives 0x0 for \RDOS, the _DOS the kernel called, 0x2a for \RADD 2 0x28, "abcd" for \RCAT "ab", Error: AE_NOT_FOUND for \RNON and 0x0 for \RTST; evprobe then reads KEY_BRIGHTNESSDOWN and KEY_BRIGHTNESSUP, each pressed and released, prints EVPROBE OK and exits 0

progress.means: a step of the manifest has ended

native.reason: the case reads a video bus of the suite's own SSDT, which only QEMU's -acpitable adds; the Lenovo's acceptance fires its own firmware's _Q11 and _Q12

cases.behavior: with rach2.noacpica the kernel leaves ACPICA out, and poweroff at the debug shell still stops the machine through the sleep types of \_S5 that acpi.c read from the DSDT

execution.cleanup: libetude-case ends the machine and removes its evidence, which it keeps after a failure

the machine ends with a shutdown, as QEMU reports a write of SLP_EN
